votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of July 2, 2024 as well as the formal meeting minutes of July 9, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved the minutes from the July 2, 2024 work session and the July 9, 2024 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 28 of 2024, declaring September 2024 National Suicide Prevention Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing September as National Suicide Prevention and Action Month.

votes.motion: Close the public protest hearing regarding the Notice of Intention to Designate Central Business Improvement Area – 25.
votes.description: The Council closed the public protest hearing for the CBIA-25 designation, which initiates a 60-day written protest period for the special assessment on commercial properties downtown.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 66 of 2024, Part 1, amending the Fiscal Year 2025 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified items (A-1, D-4, D-8, D-14, D-15).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted a partial budget amendment for FY2025, covering items such as three new FTEs in the Attorney's Office, Economic Development Loan Fund cleanup, an Impact Fees analyst FTE, a claims damage reimbursement for the tennis bubble, and acceleration of four parks capital projects.

votes.motion: Adopt a Legislative Intent requesting the Administration review and return to the Council with a recommendation for the best method, either a street or alley dedication, for Redondo Street located between approximately 800 East and Windsor Street in order to clear up the legal confusion as to the ownership of this part of Redondo Street.
votes.description: The Council adopted a legislative intent directing the Administration to investigate and recommend the best legal method to resolve ownership ambiguity for a portion of Redondo Street.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for the Northpoint Light Industrial Zoning Text Amendment and the City-wide Text Amendment for Gas Station Standards, and approving the reappointment of Colour Maisch to the Arts Design Board.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda, which set future public hearing dates for two zoning text amendment ordinances and confirmed a board reappointment to the Arts Design Board through September 3, 2027.
